title: FBI-UAP-PR006, Digital Recreation, Narrative Statement 3-2, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A video file — specifically a computer-generated 'digital recreation' (artistic animation) depicting a reported UAP incident, not actual footage.
interpretation_warnings: No source text could be extracted from the file; all facts here come from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the video content itself.
This is an artistic/digital recreation, NOT actual footage of the event — visuals were constructed, not recorded at the scene.
Single-source: the recreation rests entirely on one federal agent's first-hand account (DOW-UAP-D081); no independent corroboration is described.
The exact location is described only as 'near a sensitive national security site' in the western United States — no specific place is named.
The recreation was produced in 2026, roughly three years after the reported 2023 incident, introducing potential recall and reconstruction bias.
No named individuals, sensor types, or measured data are present — the object's nature ('unidentified anomalous phenomena') is asserted, not characterised.
